freeze.policy: Freeze model before fresh external27 evaluation; production preserves g2 and emits a new g3 version. No model tuning after validation.

measurementCaveats: Bit estimates omit coding and wire overhead.
Exact wire totals include complete View Markdown links and compare kind/n; they are standalone, not auto portfolio.
Exploratory timings were partly concurrent and are not latency guarantees.
Production changes only names/comments and replaces equivalent slice/reduce with a six-byte loop; 52 exact selected wires are replayed separately.

bits.scope: Diagnostic52, model probability cost only, kind vs unprimed minimum. No production changes.

wire.scope: Exact model-only standalone complete View Markdown lengths, frozen g2 baseline vs hypothetical g3, kind vs n prior minimum, CRC32 included. Not auto portfolio. One noisy concurrent timing pass.

productionReplay.note: Actual production arx6CompressEnvelope at defaultg3 matched every frozen candidate selected wire hash after the allocation-free masked-history loop substitution.
